description: Use this when a signed-in user wants a character or mascot animated but has no image of it yet, or asks for a new one: designing it with AI is the recommended first step of the character path. Ask what the app's designer asks: a short description, the archetype, and optionally the look, up to two personality words and up to three colours. Generates one original, front-facing character on a plain background. Uses 1 credit from the user's balance (failed or refused attempts give it back). Usually ready in under a minute: this call waits briefly, then check with get_design and show the image. Next step: create_character_set with its design_id (or retry_design for another version). No existing characters, brands or real people. Requires a linked Charmotion account.

archetype.description: What kind of character it is.

description.description: What the character is, in the user's words, e.g. 'a round cloud with rosy cheeks and tiny boots'.

name: design_character

image_url.description: The finished image (PNG/WebP); the link works for 10 minutes.

name.description: The character description, or the brand name of a logo.

next_step.description: How to animate it: create_character_set (character) or start_motion (logo) with design_id.

title: Design a character with AI
